title: LIST OF HONORARY RANKS AWARDED ON THE OCCASION OF INDEPENDENCE DAY 2026
body_text:
1.      List of Honorary Commission (Honorary Captain and Honorary Lieutenant) awarded on the occasion of Independence Day 2026 are enclosed:-
1.1. Active List Honorary Ranks.
1.2. Honorary Ranks after retirement.
1.3. Honorary Nb Sub Ranks after retirement.
SUMMARY
Ser No Rank/Award Active List After Retirement 1. Hony Capt 438 1365 2. Hony Lt 1803 485 3. Hony Sub Maj - 4225 4. Hony Sub - 776 5. Hony Nb Sub - 5897
****
Nishant/ Rinku Singh

enrichment.summary: On the occasion of Independence Day 2026, the Ministry of Defence announced honorary ranks awarded to armed forces personnel, both serving and retired. These include Honorary Captain, Honorary Lieutenant, Honorary Subedar Major, Honorary Subedar, and Honorary Naib Subedar ranks, with thousands of personnel honoured across active and post-retirement categories.
enrichment.context: Honorary ranks are ceremonial promotions granted to Junior Commissioned Officers (JCOs) in the Indian Army as a mark of distinction, typically awarded on Republic Day and Independence Day. These do not carry additional command authority or pay in most cases but confer prestige, and are often given in recognition of long, meritorious service. This is a routine annual administrative announcement listing the numbers of personnel receiving such honours in 2026, consistent with past practice, and does not indicate any new policy or scheme.
